# Fake dashboard snapshots

Invented characters only (no real character data). Each JSON file is one `DashboardSampler.snapshot()`, the object `/api/state` returns; `/api/live` is the same object without `details`, and `/api/brief` is derived from it by `dashboard-server.mjs`. Generated by `build.mjs`, which feeds invented raw reads through the real `projectDetails` and `DashboardSampler`, so the shape tracks the code. Regenerate with `node src/test/fixtures/snapshots/build.mjs`.

| File | State |
| --- | --- |
| `town-full.json` | Level 8 Breton Spellsword in Daggerfall: 12 items with mixed materials and partial condition, 1,872 gold, factions, guilds, social and legal reputation, 3 tracked quests (one with `clockSeconds` < 86400 and a confirmed destination), journal entries |
| `dungeon.json` | Same character in Castle Wolfspire (`mode: dungeon`), low vitals, an `interiorMap` with empty explored geometry |
| `new-character.json` | Level 1 character: empty pack, no quests, no factions |
| `loading.json` | Before the first read (`reason: STARTING`, no player) |
| `stale.json` | A read 15 minutes old with details 20 minutes old, followed by a failed read (`stale: true`, `READ_FAILED`) |
| `location-changed.json` | Just entered a building: `timings.deferred` holds back the `details` and `quests` panels |
| `error-page-changed.json` | `PAGE_CHANGED` |
| `error-canvas-unavailable.json` | `GAME_CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE` |
| `error-game-not-running.json` | `GAME_NOT_RUNNING` |
| `phone-brief.json` | What `/api/brief` returns for `town-full` |

## Serving

```
node scripts/serve-fixture.mjs town-full --port=9235
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:9235/` (headless: `google-chrome --headless=new --screenshot ... http://127.0.0.1:9235/`). The real `createDashboardServer` serves the fixture at `/api/state`, `/api/live`, `/api/brief`, plus the dashboard files. Timestamps are moved forward so the fixture's `serverTime` is now. Stale fixtures stay stale, and the deferral window in `location-changed` lasts 2 s from server start of each request. `--frozen` serves the timestamps exactly as stored. Game start and Refresh all do nothing.

Not filled: `appearance` (paperdoll), `map`, `townMap`, `iconUrl`, and dungeon geometry `parts`. Each needs extracted game artwork, so the UI shows its placeholders.

`town-full` reuses `../dense-town-pins.json` for `townMap`, as `/workspace/dfo-audit/harness.mjs` does. Run `npm test` on Node >= 22.15: on Node 20, 7 transport tests fail because `WebSocket` is missing.
